title: Degree of a low-degree polynomial
statement: Let $n$ and $\ell$ be nonnegative integers, and assign a coefficient in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$. The function on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ obtained by summing these coefficients times their coordinate monomials has algebraic degree at most $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: A coefficient in $\mathbb{F}_2$ for each subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$
